$comment: State texts for the P2 trial matrix. 00-hero is the operator's hero prompt verbatim; every other state is derived from it by changing only what that state shows. Variant a is the state text alone; variant b leads with the state's focus and the pose lock, then the same text. scripts/lookdev/leonardo.mjs appends the full style block (style-block.json) to either.
pose: Camera: standing eye height, pitched about 45 degrees down at the table's near edge, the near edge of the table along the bottom of the frame, the lamp agent in the upper third of the frame

states.title: Hero / target frame
states.focus: the full concept at once: a room lifted under the pointing hand, pins, a scan line, the lamp agent with its decision card, the wrist composer
states.text: First-person view through a VR headset, standing, looking down at about 45 degrees at a large waist-high table. A software product is laid out on the table as an architect's site plan: about a dozen wings in a row from left to right, each split into rooms holding small fixtures. The viewer's own hands are in frame: the left wrist shows a small floating panel, the right hand points at one room. Cinematic, wide 16:9, shallow depth of field at the table's far edge, soft volumetric light, high detail, concept art. The table is an architect's backlit light table in a dark studio. The plan is drawn in cyan and white linework on deep blueprint blue, and the room under the pointing hand rises off the paper as a translucent, paper-thin 3D extrusion with tiny fixtures inside. Small amber survey pins with paper tags stand at a few fixtures as scan findings. A thin horizontal scan line sweeps across one wing. Above the far end of the table hangs the AI agent: a calm, drafting-lamp-like presence with a warm glowing head, leaning toward the viewer. Beside it floats one paper decision card with two buttons, approve and decline. The wrist panel shows three stacked package trays, each with a small model chip and an effort dial. Palette: blueprint blue, white line, amber accents. Mood: quiet, precise, late night.
